name: IIMA Special Need Based Scholarship (PGP and PGP-FABM)

rules.quote: IIMA offers a need-based scholarship over and above the scholarships provided by the alumni, industry, and government.
All students admitted to the two-year postgraduate programmes (PGP & PGP-FABM) in the year 2024
whose gross annual family income is below INR 15 Lakh during the previous financial year are eligible to apply for this scholarship

rules.value: aid amount set by IIMA after assessing assets, dependants and other criteria
rules.quote: IIMA shall determine the financial assistance required for each applicant based on its assessment of the applicant’s economic status

rules.value: SNBS application also used to shortlist alumni and company means / merit-cum-means scholarships
rules.quote: The shortlisting for various Means and Merit-cum-Means scholarships will be done through the Institute’s Special Need Based Scholarship applications

amount.text: Need-based; amount determined per applicant (alumni endowment awards INR 1-3 lakh via SNBS)
amount.quote: IIMA shall determine the financial assistance required for each applicant

deadline.text: No dates in the rules document
